name: Stockholm City Hall
description: Follow the brick arcades to the waterfront and take a quiet moment looking across Riddarfjärden.

name: Royal Dramatic Theatre
description: Pause outside Dramaten for the sculpted façade, then continue along the harbour towards Strandvägen.

name: Skeppsbron
description: Walk the Old Town's eastern quay for open water, passing boats and a long line of warm-coloured façades.

name: Stortorget
description: Find a seat near the red and yellow houses, then explore the narrow lanes leading away from the square.
